title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Dexamethason (ausgenommen Implantat), (OBG) ATC S01BA01 für die Zeit 01.01.2025 - 31.12.2026
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Dexamethason (ausgenommen Implantat), ATC S01BA01, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.01.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.12.2026. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: E3CX-029 NEXT GENERATION ELECTRIC PROPULSION FOR EXPLORATION STUDY - EXPRO+
description: High-power Hall Effect Thrusters (HETs) are considered a key technology for deep space missions due to their balanced thrust and fuel efficiency, enabling long-distance travel, complex manoeuvres, and reduced mission durations with respect to very-high Isp systems. Compared to gridded ion engines, HETs offer a better balance of thrust and efficiency, with simpler, more robust designs. Their scalability makes them ideal for future missions involving heavy payloads and/or human exploration. Current European and U.S. developments show promising performance at higher voltage that existing high-TRL solutions, but further progress needs to be driven by mission-specific requirements. With this activity, the Agency plans to consolidate the requirements and initial design of a single thruster high-power thruster that is capable to cover the Agency's future Exploration needs.

title: ONBOARDING AND OPERATIONS COORDINATION SERVICES FOR EO SCIENCE MISSIONS
description: The "Onboarding and Operations Coordination Services" for EO Science Missions consist of engineering services to be delivered by a Service Provider possessing a diversified expertise in the EO domain including suitable engineering expertise for EO mission and data management systems as well as sound experience in the coordination of integration, testing, validation and operational activities.In addition, specific expertise will be initially needed to include heritage missions in the new approach and concept.A strong underlying competence of the Service Provider in key EO data generation and management functionalities (such as data processing, data flows and data exchange interfaces), and related security aspects is also required. Familiarity with the specificities of the applicable EO Science mission's portfolio is expected.The Onboarding and Operations Coordination Services will be deployed and operated based on a SecDevOps approach to ensure coherence between the operated services and their evolutions and to guarantee a common governance in all the phases of the framework lifecycle.It is worth highlighting that, in general terms, the Onboarding and Operations Coordination Services are not conceived to carry out specific developments nor to perform themselves EOF operational activities, ratherto coordinate specific operational services (e.g. in the domain of data processing, data access, data acquisition, data archive).Under ESA authority, the selected Service Provider will be responsible for:1. Maintenance and Evolution of the EOF-EOS Reference Architecture2. Onboarding of new missions3. End-to-end Operations coordination
